summary: Ares Core Infrastructure Fund filed an 8-K for a monthly closing sale of common shares at NAV plus distribution declarations. The fund sold ~28.8M shares for $715.5M across four classes (I, D, N, S) at April 30, 2026 NAV per share of $24.8805. These are routine ongoing share issuances and dividend announcements, not a special situation event. The sale is exempt under Regulation D and S. No special situation trigger such as merger, tender offer, or restructuring is present. The filing is a routine operational update for a BDC/interval fund.
